evidence: Has the 'Tests' label and adds unit tests in src/test/pmt_tests.cpp and src/test/pow_tests.cpp to cover consensus logic.
rationale: Adds unit test coverage for edge cases in consensus-critical partial merkle tree extraction and proof-of-work target calculations. The PR tests malformed CPartialMerkleTree boundary conditions (including the 16,666 transaction limit) and edge cases in GetBitsProof (zero, negative, and overflowing nBits), filling gaps discovered in an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s). While it does not fix an active bug, it provides worthwhile regression protection for high-risk consensus code paths.
